bidmc.name: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center standard charges
bidmc.notes: CMS hospital price transparency v2.x JSON (~28 MB). Direct from bidmc.org.

chia_prices.name: CHIA CompareCare procedure price data (Excel)
chia_prices.notes: From https://www.chiamass.gov/procedure-price-data (form-gated). Download the Excel into data/raw/chia/ and record the data year from the file. Treat as older data.

chia_relative.name: CHIA relative price tiers
chia_relative.notes: From https://www.chiamass.gov/relative-price-and-provider-price-variation/ . If no downloadable table, hand-enter into data/raw/chia_relative_price_manual.csv with columns hospital,tier_or_value,year,source_url.

lahey.name: Lahey Hospital & Medical Center (Burlington) standard charges

massgeneral.name: Massachusetts General Hospital standard charges
massgeneral.notes: ~1.8 GB CSV delivered as a ZIP from Mass General Brigham. Direct link is not script-discoverable; open https://www.massgeneral.org/notices/billing/cms-required-hospital-charge-data and download the standard charges file manually into data/raw/hospitals/.

ncci.name: CMS NCCI procedure-to-procedure (PTP) edits, practitioner + hospital
ncci.notes: From the CMS NCCI edits page. Usually behind a license click-through, so download the Column One/Column Two edit file(s) manually and export to CSV as data/raw/ncci_ptp_raw.csv.

pfs.name: CMS Physician Fee Schedule national payment amount (Oct 2026, non-QP)
pfs.notes: From https://www.cms.gov/medicare/payment/fee-schedules/physician/national-payment-amount-file/pfrev26d . Use the NON-QP file (2026 has two conversion factors). Export the payment-amount member to CSV as data/raw/cms_pfs.csv. data_source label: 'Medicare national, non-QP'.

umass.name: UMass Memorial Medical Center standard charges
umass.notes: From https://ummhealth.org/.../price-transparency . Download the standard charges file into data/raw/hospitals/.
